sanskrit_verse:
सौराक्षिकं वृथा दानं कामक्रोधप्रतिश्रुतम् ।
प्रातिभा�व्यं दण्डशुल्कशेषं पुत्रं न दापयेत् ॥
transliteration: saurākṣikaṃ vṛthā dānaṃ kāmakrodhapratiśrutam | prātibhāvyaṃ daṇḍaśulkaśeṣaṃ putraṃ na dāpayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That gift which is made without purpose, promised in desire or anger, or what remains after fines and penalties — such a son should not be given.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the purity of intention, not in the act of giving alone.
Causation is determined by the consciousness behind the action, not the appearance of the act.
Capacity-based responsibility includes the ability to discern dharmic disposition at the time of commitment.
Restoration logic demands alignment of future capacity with original dharmic intent.
Consciousness alignment requires that relational offerings reflect integrity and completeness.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an offering was made under emotional compulsion OR without conscious clarity, THEN it shall be deemed non-binding.
IF any legal obligation remains unfulfilled due to prior invalid commitments, THEN restoration occurs through realignment, NOT enforcement.
IF a relationship is offered as restitution but lacks foundational integrity, THEN it must be returned to source-consciousness for reevaluation.
IF a transaction originates from kama (desire) or krodha (anger), THEN its executability is nullified regardless of form.
supreme_court_application: In matters involving inheritance, adoption, or familial rights transfers, the Supreme Court must evaluate the originating consciousness of the act. Emotional volatility or incomplete awareness invalidates legal consequence. Only acts rooted in stable awareness qualify for judicial recognition.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that true giving arises from satvic clarity; thus, offerings born of rajas or tamas lack valid causal foundation. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that distorted origins produce misaligned outcomes. Therefore, no punitive correction is needed—only dissolution of the false contract and restoration of natural order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Return the disputed entity to the custody of pure witnessing until clarity emerges.
Initiate completion process where all involved parties acknowledge the defect in original intent.
Realign affected relationships through guided sankalpa (intention-setting) aligned with sanatana dharma.
Establish remedial samskaric cleansing to remove residual impressions of false obligation.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law flows from immutable Dharma. No punishment arises, only restoration. Consciousness is the ultimate judge. Reality conforms to Truth.
